svg.title: ニューカレドニアの旅の地図
svg.desc: グランドテール島、イル・デ・パン、ロイヤルティ諸島、ベレップ諸島の実際の海岸線。Heroと8景の地点座標は別の操作可能な地図レイヤーで示します。
svg.metadata: Natural Earth 3.1 admin0 GeoJSON, eFrane/admin0/oceania/NC.geojson public domain, https://github.com/eFrane/admin0/blob/master/oceania/NC.geojson ; source README https://github.com/eFrane/admin0/blob/master/readme.md . WGS84 local-equirectangular-fit-v1. Selection includes main islands between 163.2–168.5 E and 22.95–19.2 S; distant Walpole is off canvas. Generalised scale; not for navigation. Retrieved 2026-11-07. Additional overview inset: actual Natural Earth land polygons projected within overview and remotely located sites plotted as point markers only; dots do not represent island outlines or sizes. Positions: Chesterfield/Bellona, Huon, Surprise, Astrolabe, Walpole, Matthew and Hunter; sources include New Caledonia legal territorial list and Mapcarta/OSM gazetteers. Matthew and Hunter are disputed between France and Vanuatu as of 2026. Inset spans lon 157.5-172.5, lat 17.65-23.0 S, different scale from main detailed panel.
